title: DummyConnectorOptions
description: Constructor options for DummyConnector — local mock connector used in dev/tests. Source: packages/connector-dummy/src/DummyConnector.ts → DummyConnectorOptions.

name.description: Override the connector identifier (lets you register multiple dummies).

replyDelay.description: Milliseconds before the echo reply is returned after a message is sent.

connectDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait before connect() resolves — simulates a real handshake.

rules.description: Declarative response rules (DummyRule[]). Evaluated in order against every outgoing user message before the built-in demo commands and the echo; first match wins, no match falls through. Pattern matching only — no executable code.

capabilities.description: Simulated backend permissions for the message actions (ConnectorCapabilities), announced through onCapabilities. false hides the action; omit to allow it. Change at runtime with setCapabilities().

regenerate.description: Allow regenerating the latest bot reply.

editMessage.description: Allow editing the latest user message.

when.description: Predicate over the outgoing message. Every field that is set must match; an empty object matches every message.

type.description: Match by outgoing message type (exact comparison).

textMatches.description: Regular expression source (no slashes, no flags) tested against data.text. An invalid pattern disables the rule with a console warning.

then.description: Response emitted on a match: a static IncomingMessage (its id is replaced with a fresh one when it would collide with an earlier emission), or a GenUI chunk script.

chunks.description: AIChunk[] streamed in order under one stream id; the last chunk is flagged done.

delay.description: Milliseconds before `then` is emitted. Defaults to replyDelay.
